# 0x8586D0 first pass

No exact gain; no production changes. Nine distinct source inputs, ten compiler
launches, four written hypothesis batches. The compiler gate is released with
no jobs or leases. Baseline is retained revision 072754ebf125a77fd45f72dec41879e240c2334a,
source SHA-256 4dd5c9d76bd97041d88ca2134d85cb72bb542baa32812c7b4f5291ea29b1a059;
retained-baseline/result.json contains all 123 baseline file and symbol pairs.

Batch 1, split network conversions: port 47, session 47, port and session 26,
all three including IP 54 masked rows, versus 33 baseline. Batch 2, naming
connection UDP receiver, 45 rows (no cut from 26). Batch 3, reversing session
comparison on the 26-row input, 25 rows. Batch 4, split sender IP, sender port,
both on the 25-row input, 70 / 74 / 70 rows (no cut). Rows are diagnostics, not
proof. Every successful match run has no gain and no loss against the full 123
file and 123 symbol sets; each runs/<name>/result.json contains complete after
sets and runs/<name>/8586D0-analysis.json their explicit deltas, plus the
objdiff and object. No new claimed match or meaningful integration candidate.

The first port compilation completed, but system Python failed matching for
missing capstone. runs/first_8586D0_port_retained retains input, object and log;
its native-venv retry is a duplicate source and body, not another hypothesis.
There were no invalid semantic variants or compile errors. Original pre-rebase
drafts were never compiled. first/groups.json records every input, object, raw
and masked body SHA; nine distinct raw and masked groups, with only failed
matcher port run and its retry sharing a group. Objects differ across this
retry even though the target bodies coincide. first/retained-proposals.json,
receiver-proposal.json, comparison-proposal.json and peer-proposals.json carry
lossless edits, input/base hashes and replay verification; retained inputs and
prepare scripts are alongside them. Each run's input.json binds its snapshot.

Inspected packet parsing, sender and local socket lifetimes, exact sibling
Process_Zero_Read, exact Key_Exchange, UDP::getLocalAddr and previous full
history. The useful conversion interaction leaves retail's port store and type
load scheduled differently and connection-case call-argument registers differ;
pending-case instructions mostly match. The old scratch accessor-header gain
has no recoverable patch. A newly evidenced real accessor or function-wide
allocation mechanism, with root's all-consumer proof plan for any shared header,
is a concrete reopening condition; do not replay invented accessors or assume
all possible C++ has been searched. No independently supported source-local
lever remains here. Batch 4 is one consecutive no-cut batch after batch 3's cut.
No target audit claimed because none reached a masked match.

# 0x8586D0 Sol escalation: bounded exhaustion, no retained gain

CordMgr::Process_Go_Away_Packet remains unmatched. Five distinct compiler-input
tuples, five successful compiler launches and three prewritten causal batches
produce three raw and three relocation-masked target bodies. Every run preserves
all 125 current file/address AND symbol/address pairs and all original 122;
every complete before/after set delta is empty. No production change qualifies.
The best new scratch input improves the previous 25 diagnostic rows to 23.
Rows are diagnostics, not proof or a reason to retain an unmatched rewrite.

Model: gpt-6.1-sol, high. Work paths below are relative to
/home/dev/Projects/EnB/.work/claim-325. Current immutable revision is
bdefc60e236590ccb3ad66ca1cd02fa21d20f6e0. All five C++ inputs rebase only the
target body onto retained3-tree/app/wwudp/cordmgr.cpp, SHA256
593979273563e91df9080f64c60bca1c048dd4be28b3a87d35141673d97dfe70;
cordmgr.h is 12e0dc74710320fc81810d94469a1270b4d3f46b63effca82886cd8d631274e2,
cordcon.h is 4f0f18af7f6baaf545de1cb58502a7eab8681adb78d992ab86909003094d9e07.
ACK1, ACK2 and Pump_Connections source and all 125 pairs survive every trial.

## Investigation and complete prior context

the complete target history txt/json and current attempts display, brief/group/
Sol instructions, first-report and actual first-pass proposals/inputs/diffs,
final group/report.md, exact Process_Zero_Read and Key_Exchange, actual ArrayList,
UDP and packet-field helper implementations, and the three new solved functions'
source/audit mechanisms. Original history has 25 reported forms across three
rows, including an old failed shared-index compilation. No target stash is named.
The old Get_Ip/Get_Port/Get_Session scratch header patch remains unavailable;
neither its source nor a recovery/replay was invented.

8586D0/sol/review_evidence.py and prior-inspection.json independently bind all ten
first-pass launches: nine source hashes, nine raw/masked target bodies, actual
object hashes, references/unwind metadata, analysis and full source-diff hashes.

is the same source/body. Successful first-pass match runs preserve 123 pairs.
The first tier's real outcomes remain port+session splits 33 to 26, comparison 25,

their scores. Complete source diffs are sol/first_8586D0_*-full-source.diff.

Independent critique: retail initializes the real con and c pointers in their
own switch branches, while the previous 25-row form hoists both null operations.
Old case-local attempts predate actual packet load/conversion splits. The newly
audited ACK2 and Pump_Connections real pointer lifetime changes provide a concrete
reason to investigate that interaction on the improved source. They do not
guarantee another function's allocation will follow the same result.

connection case still uses wrong scratch registers and receiver/argument schedule.
Thus the isolation result supplies evidence, not a matched function.

Batch3 hypothesis3.md is explicitly a fresh helper hypothesis. Missing old code

target/field evidence. Only the three existing guarded con reads are replaced,

## Bounded exhaustion and release

Batch 1 no-cut; batch 2 cuts 25 to 23; batch 3 no-cut. This is one consecutive no-cut
batch after the latest cut, not a three-batch or eight-batch limit claim. Stop is
honest bounded exhaustion: both actual case lifetimes were tested together and
individually, and the legitimate fresh getter mechanism is now an actual body
duplicate. There is no observed improvement supporting a further getter/context
interaction; root explicitly prohibited getter spelling/type/const sweeps and
followups without actual progress. No arbitrary quota was used.

A bounded scan of exact-leading trivial getter patterns at discovered retail
function starts finds none in wwudp. Generic getters elsewhere do not identify
CordCon; this does not prove no equivalent getter exists, nor forbid the fresh
neutral accessor hypothesis that was actually tested. Existing packet integer
helpers have variable-length semantics and are unsuitable replacements for
these fixed fields. Moving reads across guards, omitting conversions/null output
initialization or adding synthetic storage/dead reads would not be valid fixes.
Prior named receiver and peer conversions already had actual worse outcomes;
their repetition without a complementary observed effect is not a new lever.

Reopen on concrete original/helper evidence or a demonstrated real allocation/
lifetime mechanism explaining the surviving parse store/type-load schedule and
connection receiver/scratch registers while preserving the actual operations.
Recovering the old exact accessor patch would be useful evidence but would still
require comparison with the new tested neutral getters and proper consumer proof.
This does not claim every equivalent C++ form has been searched.

Compiler gate explicitly RELEASED after the fifth completed run; no jobs or VM
leases held. Staging C++ and both header hashes were verified restored to the
retained3 hashes above; tracked working tree was clean. Only own scratch and run
evidence was written. No production/header/snapshot/inventory/commit or GitHub
mutation was made. No further worker compilation is planned.
